description: Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird says recommendations about increased staffing and funding for existing Medicaid fraud elimination efforts will come at later meetings of the state Medicaid Fraud Elimination Task Force. The task force was established by executive order July 1 by Gov. Kim Reynolds. It is charged with submitting a final report by Oct. 29, 2026 for the governor…
